title: Decay Chains
description: Uranium becomes thorium, then radium, then radon, then polonium and at last lead; fourteen steps, each with its own half-life. Wait long enough and every step runs as fast as the slowest feeds it. Unlocks Radiogenic Lead and Lead Shielding.

puzzle.goal: A long-lived parent (half-life T _ 1) feeds a short-lived daughter (half-life T _ 2). After a while the daughter is made as fast as it decays and its amount stops changing. Write how many daughter nuclei M sit alongside N parent nuclei.
puzzle.name: Secular equilibrium
puzzle.ask: Find M for a speck of radium holding N = @{N} nuclei (T = @{T} s), with its radon (R = 3.30e5 s).
puzzle.method: When nothing changes, the daughter decays as fast as it forms: λ₂M = λ₁N, and each λ is ln 2 over its half-life.
